tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get key facts about Marché CTFO: what it is, where it delivers, how ordering works, supported languages and currency, and links to the machine-readable catalog.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the Marché CTFO grocery categories with their page URLs, so an agent can browse the catalog by department.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Marché CTFO grocery catalog by keyword and get matching in-stock products with their price, unit, and product page URL. Prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD).

query.description: Keywords to search for, e.g. 'organic bananas'.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-24, default 10).
